own_solution.law: The hydrostatic pressure contribution is Δp = ρgh = 13600 × 9.81 × 0.1 = 13341.6 Pa.
assumptions: The mercury is at rest with uniform density.
Gravity is uniform; use the conventional terrestrial value g = 9.81 m/s².
The requested contribution is the pressure increase relative to the surface.

notes: All four legacy variants give the same answer. Column B's height is structurally disconnected (D), including either value reported in each variant. The later revisions make the presentation slightly artificial but do not affect the target. Gravity is not specified numerically; using the also customary g = 9.8 m/s² gives 13328 Pa, approximately the same 13.3 kPa contribution. The legacy renderings use different heights as parameter variants; they are not presented as same-value sentence pairs.
